The '''Republic Ventral Sweep Wing Shuttle''' was a vessel used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

Its design was unusual in that it flew with one wing pointed straight down and a second pointed backwards with a single blue engine to either side.<ref name="KotOR13">[[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]</ref>  In landed configuration the ventral wing rotated back, in an almost scissor action to meet the rear wing. The ship utilised three landing gear, one forward of the main fuselage and one to each side of the now folded wing.<ref name="KotOR15">[[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]]</ref> The asymmetrical hull had a boarding ramp on its starboard side.<ref name="KotOR10">[[Knights of the Old Republic 10|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 10]]</ref>
